html:
Sessions is a documentation hub of hands-on sessions and beginner-friendly tutorials, live at sessions.justfahad.me. It's built on Eleventy LibDoc (forked from ita-design-system/eleventy-libdoc), an easy-to-use, content-focused starter for crafting slick, responsive documentation.

✨ Key features

  • Content-focused, accessible, and performant (vanilla JS components)
  • Fuzzy and standard search modes
  • Smart navigation and floating table of content
  • Works without JavaScript, printable
  • Light and dark modes, slick code highlighting, sandboxes
  • Atom feed for blog content
